task.title: Build system and product TUI navigation
task.summary: Implement `/wiki system <diagram type>` and `/wiki product` terminal navigation from canonical KB diagrams and product docs.

goal.outcome: Users can browse source-backed system diagrams and product knowledge in the terminal through `/wiki system <diagram type>` and `/wiki product`.
acceptance: `/wiki system <diagram type>` lists available canonical diagram types and renders the selected diagram from `.codewiki/kb/system/diagrams/**` or a generated lens derived from those sources.
The system diagram TUI lets users move between components or flows, highlights the selected item in ASCII/Unicode, and opens or renders the linked component/flow Markdown source on Enter.
System diagram rendering uses focused lanes, neighborhoods, ordered steps, state transitions, trees, or entity cards instead of full raw graph output.
`/wiki product` offers overview or users as the top-level choice; overview opens or renders `.codewiki/kb/product/overview.md`.
The product users view lists product users, lets users toggle each user's stories, and opens or renders the corresponding product KB Markdown source on Enter.
Views show source refs and omitted-count/focus metadata when content is summarized.
TUI output does not create hidden UI-only truth and does not depend on deprecated browser UI code.
non_goals: Do not implement a browser dashboard.
Do not render the full generated graph by default.
Do not implement all future diagram layouts beyond the existing canonical diagram families needed for first useful navigation.
Do not change canonical diagram YAML schema unless a focused validation need requires it.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: `/wiki system <diagram type>` lists available canonical diagram types and renders the selected diagram from `.codewiki/kb/system/diagrams/**` or a generated lens derived from those sources.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: `runSystemCommand` resolves the CodeWiki repo, preselects a requested diagram kind/name, and opens the status panel on the system section; `readSystemDiagramCatalog` now parses canonical YAML through `parseSystemDiagrams`.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: The system diagram TUI lets users move between components or flows, highlights the selected item in ASCII/Unicode, and opens or renders the linked component/flow Markdown source on Enter.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: System panel uses up/down to move diagrams and left/right to move source-backed focus items; selected rows use `highlightSelectable`; Enter renders selected item details plus Markdown preview when a diagram ref has a linked source.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: System diagram rendering uses focused lanes, neighborhoods, ordered steps, state transitions, trees, or entity cards instead of full raw graph output.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: `renderSystemDiagramDetailLines` renders diagram-kind-specific layouts for sequence steps, state transitions, data-model entity cards, file-structure ownership trees, and grouped focused lanes/neighborhood edges.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: `/wiki product` offers overview or users as the top-level choice; overview opens or renders `.codewiki/kb/product/overview.md`.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: `runProductCommand` opens the product section; product rendering exposes overview/users top-level choices and renders product overview preview from `.codewiki/kb/product/overview.md`.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: The product users view lists product users, lets users toggle each user's stories, and opens or renders the corresponding product KB Markdown source on Enter.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Product panel uses left/right to switch overview/users, up/down to select user cards, selected user story preview is shown from Markdown, and Enter renders the selected user KB source preview.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Views show source refs and omitted-count/focus metadata when content is summarized.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Product and system panels render source refs plus `focus`, `diagram`, `item`, and `omitted` metadata for summarized rows.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: TUI output does not create hidden UI-only truth and does not depend on deprecated browser UI code.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: The implementation reads canonical Markdown/YAML and generated status graph only; no browser UI files or new UI-only stores were introduced.
